scope: Capacity abstraction and admission combinational rule; not a new RTL simulation or formal proof.
reset: Excluded from normal state enumeration; RTL forces arready=000 during reset.
assumptions: R has at most one source; retirement requires a live completed source head and ready.
The capacity enumeration permits each nonempty source as an abstract R choice, without proving when its head completes.
arvalid=1 implies src=0/1/2; arready=000 requires arvalid=0.
arvalid=0 is one action class; all src values are ignored and equivalent for occupancy.
checks: Transcribed p_4 readiness equals the invariant after tentative acceptance.
Every enumerated transition conserves accepted AR minus retired R counts.
Every next state retains the 9-entry and per-source first-entry guarantees.
